changeSet.author: Fiter
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE m_prequalification_group ADD INDEX idx_pq_supervision_office_id (supervision_office_id);

changeSet.author: Fiter
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_prequalification_group g INNER JOIN ( SELECT ma.id AS agency_id, MIN(mo.id) AS supervision_office_id FROM m_agency ma INNER JOIN m_office mo ON ma.linked_office_id = mo.parent_id GROUP BY ma.id ) agencyOffice ON agencyOffice.agency_id = g.agency_id SET g.supervision_office_id = agencyOffice.supervision_office_id WHERE g.prequalification_type_enum = 2 AND g.supervision_office_id IS NULL;

changeSet.author: Fiter
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_prequalification_group g INNER JOIN ( SELECT mpgm.group_id, MIN(ms.linked_office_id) AS supervision_office_id FROM m_prequalification_group_members mpgm INNER JOIN m_client mc ON mc.dpi = mpgm.dpi INNER JOIN m_group_client mgc ON mgc.client_id = mc.id INNER JOIN m_group mg ON mg.id = mgc.group_id INNER JOIN m_group center ON center.id = mg.parent_id INNER JOIN m_portfolio mp ON mp.id = center.portfolio_id INNER JOIN m_supervision ms ON ms.id = mp.supervision_id GROUP BY mpgm.group_id ) memberOffice ON memberOffice.group_id = g.id SET g.supervision_office_id = memberOffice.supervision_office_id WHERE g.prequalification_type_enum IN (1, 4) AND g.supervision_office_id IS NULL;
